_comment: Marginal on-disk cost of one more worktree of a dependency tree: files AND directories, de-duplicated by (st_dev, st_ino). 'shared' means EVERY link to the inode lives outside the walked tree — NOT st_nlink > 1, which counts in-tree names too and is the discredited predicate from N30's attempt 3. Regenerate with scripts/measure/worktree_bytes.py <tree>. Only the basename is recorded: the absolute path is a local detail, and the figure that travels is the shared share, not the machine.
